Generated gVisor netstack for Linux amd64; included as source for self-contained builds.
Upstream: https://github.com/google/gvisor
Upstream commit: 95eb5d5930b0e7736826cc2cb949ba9d2c4d5d29
Profiles: native, windows, macos, linux. Default profile: windows.
Xray WireGuard and TUN consumers explicitly request native.
All custom modifications and integration were implemented entirely by AI (OpenAI Codex).
